videos.desc: A woman and a burly man arm-wrestle fiercely at a kitchen table while the family and a grandma watch. Neither can push the other's hand down, and the match ends with both arms collapsing at the same time and everyone laughing as grandma lays a towel over their locked fists.

In a 3D-animated casino, a woman in a green suit slams a tower of chips onto red at a spinning wheel; she and a nervous man despair as the wheel lands, then she wins a huge pile of chips and celebrates wildly.

In a 3D-animated climbing gym, a young woman fights her way up a tall climbing wall, gritting her teeth, slipping and dangling on the rope but refusing to quit. She hauls herself over the top edge and raises both fists as the crowd below cheers.

In a gymnastics hall, athletes push three foam blocks together to build a three-step winners' podium while teammates watch. Three gymnasts in tracksuits climb onto first, second and third place; the winner in the middle throws her arms up, then all three join hands, wave and bow.

In a hand-painted animated athletics meet a girl arches over the high-jump bar and lands on the mat without knocking it off. An official waves a green flag, the crowd and rival jumpers applaud, and she pumps her fists — she is through to the next round.

In a Ghibli-style seaside village, crowds watch an arm-wrestling tournament at rows of tables while an official moves portrait tokens up a wooden bracket board after each match; a small bald boy beats a huge bearded sailor in the final and is lifted up as champion.
videos.said: Ready, go! You are strong. Champion on the left!

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime rowing race, a determined crew sprints their red boat down a lantern-lined river and crosses the finish line first, breaking the tape. They raise their oars, hug, and carry the rower on their shoulders while the crowd cheers.

A medieval re-enactment battle on a grass field in front of a large crowd. A bald, red-bearded man in chainmail and steel arm and leg armour shoves forward behind a painted round shield, roaring. Two knots of fighters slam into each other and grind together, shields locked, shoving and swinging. One fighter is knocked down and lies on the grass while the others keep pushing over him. Spectators watch from behind a rope barrier with flags flying above them.

A viking re-enactment in front of a packed grandstand. A grinning red-bearded warrior crouches behind a big round blue shield with a metal boss. He and the fighters beside him lock their painted shields into a solid wall, then break into a run and rush forward together across the grass, shields level and heads down. Bodies go down on the field. The clip ends with the red-bearded man standing over the fallen, raising his sword in one hand and his shield in the other.

At an outdoor event a crowd presses against a barrier to watch an arm-wrestling table. A woman with a red flower in her hair grips hands with a man across the padded table, both leaning in with their elbows planted on the pads. Their faces strain and their mouths open as they push; the crowd behind them laughs and reacts. In the last seconds the tension breaks and the same people sit together laughing, holding plastic cups of drink at the table.

A young man in a white apron is baking in a bright kitchen. He looks worried at the hob, where a pale pancake sits in a frying pan and he prods it with a spatula. He pulls on black oven gloves and opens the oven, which glows orange inside. He lifts out a baking tray of biscuits that have come out completely black and cracked, holds it up, and leans over it with his face screwed up in disappointment.

At an outdoor strength contest a woman in a black lifting suit and belt presses a loaded barbell overhead, then hauls a huge grey stone up to her chest and above her head. Next she balances a thick length of tree trunk, bark still on and the sawn end showing, across her shoulders, and finally holds a small black car over her head while the crowd watches from behind a rope.

An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries. A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.

A woman in paint-spattered dungarees and a headband paints the last strokes of a huge mural of suns and waves on a city wall from a stepladder, then climbs down, backs onto the pavement and stands with her hands on her hips, looking up at the finished painting and smiling.

A ceremonial hall hung with flags: a silver-haired woman in a dark dress uniform and white gloves pins a decoration onto the chest of a young man in black tie, while a rank of soldiers in dress uniform stands to one side. She moves along the line to the next man and pins a medal on him too. The camera then pulls back to reveal the man she is decorating: his whole chest and stomach are plated with hundreds of medals and ribbons in overlapping rows, from collar to waist. He beams and laughs as she adds one more.

A player in a paint-spattered boiler suit and helmet kneels behind a wooden barricade on a field of hay bales and oil drums, aiming a paintball marker. Paint bursts near him, he sets the marker down on the ground, raises one gloved hand, then stands up with both arms high above his head, grinning, as other players walk in behind him.

A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.

A sailing race on dark blue water on a clear sunny day. A white dinghy with a bright blue sail rounds a big orange inflatable buoy in first place, spraying water. At the helm a young man with ginger hair, in an olive jacket, pulls on a rope, looks back over his shoulder and shouts with excitement, while a crew member in a cap sits behind him. Several other boats with white and blue sails follow some way behind, and a row of flags stands on the green shore.

At the finish of a road race on a sunny avenue lined with tall trees, metal barriers and colourful bunting, a young woman with long braids, in a light blue sports top and black shorts, runs through the white finishing tape with both arms raised high and a huge smile. She slows down and covers her face with her hands. A young man in a rust T-shirt and a young woman in a mustard hoodie hold the ends of the tape, and she bends to pick up her end. Spectators behind the barriers cheer, and paper cups lie scattered on the road.

In a snowy clearing among pine trees under a cloudy winter sky, a young woman with blonde braids, in a bright red snowsuit, jumps down from the top of a tall snow wall, sending snow flying, and a bearded man in a red jacket leaps down after her. At the bottom a laughing young woman in a light blue jacket lies back in the snow, and a man in a light blue jacket and black beanie raises his arms to block them and throws snow. The woman in red lands and throws both arms up in triumph. A tiny snowman stands at the foot of the wall.

At an outdoor skatepark in the evening, a young man in a rust T-shirt and jeans, one foot on a skateboard, laughs and shakes hands with a young woman with a blonde ponytail in a light blue crop top and matching trousers, her other hand on her hip. He points at a long flight of concrete stairs with a metal handrail, and after the handshake she points at him and then at the stairs, laughing. A few banknotes lie on the concrete ledge beside them. Other skaters stand at the top of the stairs.

On an athletics podium on the grass of a floodlit stadium at dusk, a young woman in a navy crop top and briefs, her long braids in a ponytail, stands on the lower step with her arms crossed and a silver medal on her chest, scowling and looking away. On the higher step a young woman in white smiles and raises a gold medal high above her head, holding a bouquet. The view moves closer to the scowling woman until her angry face fills most of the view. Empty stands and bright floodlights are behind.

In a dusty village square on a sunny afternoon with trees, colourful bunting and a cart with a wooden barrel, a young man in a grey sleeveless top and dark trousers crouches with his legs wide, grips a huge round boulder with both hands and slowly lifts it off the ground in a cloud of dust, his face tight with effort. Two old men with walking sticks sit on chairs and watch closely, other villagers stand behind them and a dog lies in the shade.

At a big indoor swimming pool a young woman in a navy swimsuit and white cap bursts up out of the water at the wall, raises both fists and shouts, her goggles in one hand. She drops down, smiles, then throws her arms up again and screams with joy. A large screen above shows NEW 55.12s with a gold star and the line PREVIOUS RECORD: 56.08s. A swimmer in the next lane stares with her mouth open, officials in white stand on the pool deck, and a packed crowd cheers in the stands.

On a steep cobbled street in a seaside town, a young woman with red hair, a flowered helmet, goggles and dungarees hurtles down the hill in an old white bathtub on iron wheels, one wheel off the ground, dust flying, between rows of hay bales. A marshal in a yellow vest dives aside. The bathtub rolls towards the camera and slows, and she pushes up her goggles and throws both arms in the air, screaming with joy. Crowds behind metal barriers and on a balcony cheer below pastel houses and a church tower.

In a lavish gambling hall with a gold ceiling and crystal chandeliers, a roulette wheel and stacks of chips stand in the foreground. Behind it a serious young man in a black tuxedo with a bow tie and a red rose stands beside an old dirty wheelbarrow piled high with red, black and gold chips. A young croupier with a black bob, a waistcoat and a bow tie holds a long rake, a young woman in a green sequin dress laughs behind her hand, and a young man in a velvet jacket sits at a card table.

At the finish of a mountain race in a village square with wet cobbles at night, a young woman runner covered in mud, with a race number and a running vest, stands under a wooden finish arch laughing and crying with joy while holding a black and white border collie. She kneels down and hugs the dog, and a steward in an orange vest wraps a gold foil blanket around her shoulders. People cheer around her, and a line of small headlamps zigzags down the dark misty mountain behind.

A tug of war at a rainy country fair. A heavy man in a striped rugby shirt is pulled forward by the rope through a muddy puddle until he slides along it on his front, while his teammates lie in a heap in the mud behind. At the other end, women in jeans and aprons pull hard, then fall back laughing; one sits in the mud cheering and two hug. A young referee in a rain jacket raises a flag. Spectators with umbrellas watch behind bunting, next to a white tent with tea urns.

On a dusty country lane in warm evening light, two women in black cycling kit and helmets ride road bikes towards the camera past hay bales. The leader on the right rides close to the bales with a focused face, and the second rider follows a little behind her and to the left. A crowd of spectators stands behind metal barriers, a man on the right reaches out his hand towards the leader, and a team car with bikes on the roof follows through the dust under tall poplar trees.

In a narrow old town street with balconies, a young woman in a white T-shirt, work trousers and fingerless gloves catches a coin she has tossed into the air, then holds it up between her fingers and looks at it with a small smile. Beside her a bearded man in navy overalls leans with his arms folded against an upright piano on a hand trolley, wrapped in a moving blanket, and then bends to the trolley. Neighbours watch from balconies and a doorway, and a man on a scooter waits behind.

A tug of war at a muddy country show on a grey day. A stocky young man in a dirty grey work shirt and khaki trousers leans far back and pulls hard on a thick rope wound around his body, his face tight with effort, as dust and churned mud fly around his boots. His opponents slip and fall onto their knees and into the dirt. He stands up straight, raises both fists in the air and roars. A crowd of people behind a rope barrier claps and cheers, and a big canvas tent and cattle pens stand in the background.

A cold outdoor swimming race on a grassy riverbank. A young man in a black sleeveless swim top and shorts stands barefoot, pulls on a printed swim cap and goggles, then walks past a rope and steps into the brown river. A young woman beside him adjusts her goggles. A marshal in a yellow hi-vis vest holds up a clipboard next to a chalkboard of numbers, a crowd in winter coats stands behind a rope near piles of clothes and shoes, and a line of orange buoys floats on the water.

A baking contest under a white tent in a park. A golden retriever in a green jacket with a blue rosette pinned on it acts as the judge and puts a second blue rosette next to a plate of sausages, then bends down and sniffs the sausages before standing up again, clearly happy. A cat in a white chef's jacket raises its paws beside a tall strawberry cake, and a rabbit in a striped apron stands next to a tart. A chocolate cake and jugs of lemonade complete the long white table.

An autumn harvest fair with hay bales, a white tent and a carousel. A long wooden plank lies across the tops of two huge orange pumpkins that are exactly the same height, so the plank is perfectly level. A young woman in a flat cap and green jacket crouches behind it checking, then stands up between the pumpkins. A young man in a checked shirt and dungarees clenches his fists, a young woman covers her mouth, and two more people watch from the hay bales. Crates of apples stand to the side.

The finish of a muddy obstacle race in a pine forest. A young man covered from head to toe in mud, his T-shirt, shorts and shoes soaked brown, bows his head as a young blonde woman in a yellow T-shirt hangs a medal on a red ribbon around his neck. He lifts his head and grins proudly, and she smiles and pats his shoulder. Behind them are a tall wooden climbing wall with a net, a pool of brown water, hay bales and a table, and sunlight breaks through the clouds.

Two young people sandboarding down a huge orange sand dune under a clear blue sky. A young woman in a yellow top and black shorts crouches low on her board and speeds down in front, her braids flying and sand spraying up behind her, and she laughs. Further up the slope a young man in a white open shirt and navy shorts rides his board more slowly behind her, his arms spread out for balance. A four-wheel-drive car and a lone tree stand far below at the foot of the dune.

A tug of war on a sunny tropical beach with palm trees and a volleyball net. A young woman in a coral bikini top and black shorts holds her end of the thick rope alone, feet dug deep into the sand, calm and smiling. On the other end several young men in swim shorts pull with all their strength, straining and grimacing, but the red marker ribbon on the rope hardly moves, and in the end the men fall back onto the sand. Friends watch from behind, one holding her head in disbelief.

The driver's seat of a go-kart on a sunny outdoor track, with the viewer's hands in black and red racing gloves on the steering wheel. Above the track a start signal on a metal pole shows green. A young woman in an orange high-visibility vest leans forward and waves the karts on, two karts with drivers in red and yellow helmets race away throwing up dust, and the viewer's kart follows down the empty track. Stacks of tyres, red and white kerbs and blossoming trees line the track.
